newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hansapank ups 1996 dividend, sets bonus.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank ups 1996 dividend, sets bonus.

text.p: Estonia's Hansapank, the biggest bank in the Baltic states, on Monday proposed a cash dividend of 1.25 kroons per share for 1996 -- up from one kroon for 1995 -- plus one new share for each existing share held.

The bank, which in January reported net non-consolidated profit up at 234 million kroons versus 149 million in 1995, said its consolidated net income surged over 70 percent in 1996 to 297.5 million Estonian kroons from 172.7 million in 1995.
"Hansapank's board of directors approved the 1996 audited net profits of Hansapank - 233.6 million kroons, and Hansapank Group - 297.5 million kroons," it said.
